title: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: The Pixel 11 lineup specs and pricing have leaked ahead of the August 12th event, showing a $100 price increase to $899 for the base model with 256GB storage. Android Headlines claims to have the specs and price for the entire Pixel 11 lineup. What the site shared basically lines up with everything else that we've heard in the lead-up to the August 12th event. The Pixel 11 is expected to get a $100 price hike, starting at $899, but will come with 256GB of storage instead of 128GB in the base model. While the entire lineup will sport the new Tensor G6 and Titan M3 chips, the base model Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are both getting that rumored RAM cut to just 12GB, along with price increases to $1,099 and $1,299, respectively.

Angela Nissel smiles through the pain. | Image: Angela Nissel
